overview: Google's new Gemini Neon model dominated the feed, with Hassabis, Pichai, Musk and Matthew Berman all praising it, while Anthropic's IPO is described as happening today, with deep dives from Social Capital and No Priors. On the markets side, Burry's updated holdings show him exiting Alphabet and trimming AI shorts, and Ackman flagged index buying in $PS.

top_items.title: MatthewBerman - Calls Gemini Neon 'very good'; Google's TianfuF says Neon is a small model approaching Fable and Astra
sundarpichai - Says Gemini Neon is also No. 1 on Cursorbench, replying to Elon Musk calling it 'a banger'
chamath - Recommends Social Capital's 3-month Anthropic deep dive, posted ahead of what it calls tomorrow's IPO
burrytracker - Burry's updated holdings: exiting Alphabet, puts on NVDA, PLTR, MU and SMH, top longs MELI and Temple & Webster
steipete - GPT-6.2 Astra/Sol reportedly don't cache top-level instructions, raising API bills; fix landed in OpenClaw
BillAckman - Says Pershing Square $PS joins the Russell 3000 on Dec 11, requiring an estimated ~5M share purchase by index funds
sundarpichai - Google's Willow chip won the 'impossible' magic square game 98.3% of the time vs. a 88.9% classical limit
brian_armstrong - Coinbase crypto options, powered by Deribit, are now live for non-US users, with US access 'coming soon'
